claim: MCP specification 2026-07-28, Authorization: authorization is OPTIONAL; HTTP transports SHOULD use it, STDIO SHOULD NOT (credentials from the environment); based on OAuth 2.1 with RFC 8707 resource indicators (the resource parameter MUST be sent and MCP servers MUST validate the token audience); MCP servers 'MUST NOT accept or transit any other tokens'; insufficient scope returns 403 with the required scopes and clients SHOULD do a step-up authorization flow

OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025, LLM01 Prompt Injection: indirect injection 'occurs when an LLM accepts input from external sources, such as websites or files'; mitigations include restricting the model's privileges to the minimum, 'human-in-the-loop controls for privileged operations', and separating and clearly denoting untrusted content; no method is presented as foolproof
